intent.outcome: All loading spinners use bubbles spinner.Dots (8-frame braille) styled with AccentColor (Mauve after M14), and existing Loading... / Searching... labels stay next to the spinner.

problem.description: spinner.New uses style.SubtleText and bubbles defaults to Line (not Dots). Several render sites also wrap spinner.View() in SubtleText again, so the spinner stays gray and easy to miss next to empty panels.

in_scope: In internal/gui/gui.go: set spinner model to spinner.Dots explicitly (do not rely on New default — default is Line). Style with style.AccentText (or WithStyle equivalent resolving to AccentColor).

Remove/replace SubtleText wrappers around m.spinner.View() in internal/gui/render.go so the Accent style is not overridden (sidebar title spinner, main content Loading..., tab-content loading, search Searching...).
Preserve existing label strings: ' Loading...', ' Searching...' (leading space as today).
Unit or smoke-level assertion that spinner Spinner field is Dots and style uses Accent; optional View() string non-empty while loading.
out_of_scope: M14 theme/sidebar/log work (depends_on 14; AccentColor is Mauve only after M14).
Per-panel state indicators beyond the existing title/main spinners.
Changing frame set away from spinner.Dots.
panel.go emptyPanel 'Loading...' path without spinner (leave as-is unless it already uses spinner).

acceptance_criteria.description: Spinner foreground uses AccentColor (via AccentText / WithStyle), not SubtleText.
Spinner animation set is spinner.Dots (bubbles braille frames; 8 frames). Explicitly assigned — not relying on New default.
Loading label text is preserved alongside the spinner at main-content and search sites (" Loading..." / " Searching...").

design_decisions.choice: Explicit spinner.Dots + AccentText; fix call sites that re-wrap View() in SubtleText
design_decisions.rationale: bubbles spinner.New defaults to Line, not Dots. Init WithStyle is insufficient if render.go wraps View() in SubtleText (lipgloss outer style wins for fg). Dots is the portable braille set (8 frames).

work_packages.name: Spinner upgrade
work_packages.goal: Dots + Accent spinner without SubtleText override; keep Loading labels.
work_packages.rollback: Revert gui.go spinner init and render.go View wrappers.

steps.action: In gui.go New/init: s := spinner.New(spinner.WithStyle(style.AccentText)); s.Spinner = spinner.Dots (or equivalent option if available). Do not leave default Line spinner.
steps.done_when: Model.spinner uses Dots frames and AccentText style at construction

steps.action: In render.go, stop wrapping m.spinner.View() with style.SubtleText.Render(...). Keep adjacent labels: SubtleText.Render(" Loading...") / " Searching..." as separate segments so only the spinner glyph is Accent-colored. Sites: sidebar title loading, panel.loading branch, tab-content loading branches, search searching branch.
steps.done_when: No SubtleText wrap around spinner.View(); labels still present

steps.action: Add tests asserting spinner.Spinner equals spinner.Dots (or frame set identity) and construction style is Accent; optional render path still contains Loading... when panel.loading. Run full gui package tests.
steps.done_when: Spinner tests green; gui package green
